Author: OOFGames
Name: Chocobo Racing
Punchline: Host live Chocobo Racing events with zero manual bookkeeping.
Description: Host live Chocobo Racing events at your venue with zero manual bookkeeping. Bets are captured from party and alliance chat automatically, player banks track every balance, and payouts are calculated at the click of a button. Run 2-10 chocobos with custom track lengths, odds, and branded chat messages. Full race history and profit/loss reporting included. Spectators can watch live and your players can place bets online with a PIN with the brand new webview feature.
Changelog:
- You can now adjust the pot while mid regisration for chocobo raffle.
- New sounds setting, you can now get alerted when someone uses the join keyword for chocobo raffle.
- New advertise button to customise your advert message. Include game info or the url if hosting via webview in this message!
- You can now share your game/chat settings through preset export and imports
- Placeholders for chat messages are now more descriptive.
